notes:
- New tool: Phase Parameter Sync keeps combined created and demolished phase codes up to date from their three source values. It can run automatically as the model changes or manually from the ribbon.
- View Template Diff now uses the term role model, supports standard Shift/Ctrl multi-selection, groups matching follower values, and shows how many selected templates differ from the role model.
- Batch Link Files can save the modified document before linking; this is enabled by default.
- Unfinished tools and dialogs are now explicitly labelled UNFINISHED before use.
- Preferences now shows the actual SDX product version, including preview labels.
- The telemetry screen has clearer charts, sortable usage sections, a raw-payload viewer, and regularly refreshed aggregated usage statistics.
- Usage reports now include the Revit build and runtime version for more reliable diagnostics.
- Update prompts appear at most once every 16 hours. Ignore this version suppresses prompts for that specific release while manual updates remain available.
- What’s Changed records a release as read only after the window closes, handles Escape correctly, and shows a fallback when notes cannot be loaded.
- The updater waits for the final open Revit session before updating, clearly indicates that it is waiting, and offers Force Close Revit when needed.
- Updates now prefer a dedicated SDX Updater.exe, verify both it and the PowerShell fallback before running, and use the consistent SDX-Updater name.
- A standalone updater can install or update SDX without starting Revit, choose Stable or Preview, and target one or more Revit versions. It remembers the selected channel.
- Release packages now include the updater executable and PowerShell fallback, with checksums verifying the updater files before use.
